# Tim Fallon's website

Source for <https://photocyte.github.io/>. Articles, author information, media,
and established URLs are preserved; the Hydejack-derived theme is maintained
in this repository under `_theme`.

Start with the [development container instructions](../.devcontainer/README.md).
See [MAINTENANCE.md](../MAINTENANCE.md) for the dependency baseline, builds,
security checks, upstream provenance, deployment, and rollback procedure.

GitHub Actions builds and tests the site before publishing to GitHub Pages.
This guide and MAINTENANCE.md supersede the older remote-theme instructions
in the root README.
